Name: (Even More) Tib's Tractor Skins
Author: steevejr
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/tzEYL4w.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/TxMW9y6.png[/img]

I absolutely adore ﻿﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12830]Tibs Tractor Skins[/url]﻿, but I wish there were more colors. So I made more colors.
﻿And now there's a tractor for basically any color anyone could ever want. And it could be yours today!

Included are regular colors, some darks, some pastels, and three rainbows (just for fun!).
I've also made some desaturated versions for the people who use toned down maps.
Also there is a brown. I didn't add it to the previews, because it's a boring brown.

The original ﻿﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12830]Tibs Tractor Skins[/url]﻿ has some very nice primary colors, and includes a[b] black, gray, [/b]and[b] warm white. [/b]Check it out!!
﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/iMGSUrr.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/T4lPmWo.png[/img]

[u][b](Alternative Textures)[/b][/u]

This is an Alternative Textures mod, so you will need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿. Simply drop my mod into your mods folder.
You will need to go to [b]Robin[/b] to buy the [b]Scissors[/b]; use them on your tractor to change the skin.

[u][b](Content Patcher)[/b][/u]

This is [b]not [/b]a CP mod, but it's very easy to replace the default tractor skin on your own.
1. Pick whichever tractor you'd like to use
2. Rename the image to [b]tractor.png[/b]
3. Open your mods folder and go to [b]TractorMod > assets[/b]
4. Paste your image. Allow it to overwrite. Done!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/jPCwpsB.png[/img]

You have two options in the downloads: [b]regular[/b], or [b]desaturated[/b].
You can have both, if you really really want.


[size=4][b]Bonus[/b]:[/size]
I've also made a very yucky, rusty skin to use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20703]Questable Tractor[/url]﻿ mod.
This is the rusty hunk of junk you find on your farm that you later repair.

[u]To install:[/u]
1. Open your mods folder and go to [b]QuestableTractor > assets[/b]
3. Copy[b] ﻿rustyTractor.png[/b] from my mod and paste it into [b]assets[/b]
4. Allow it to overwrite. Now you have a matching yucky tractor!
﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/m0vu3uj.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7yd55k2.png[/img]

Thank you Noitibmar for the beautiful tractor skins and for the very generously open permissions!

aaaaand with a sneaky cameo by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13437]Rodney[/url]﻿!
